title: Basic Commands [sed]
description:
# sed
`sed` stands for **Stream Editor**. It finds and replaces text in files.
```bash
sed 's/old/new/' filename       # prints with replacement
sed -i 's/old/new/' filename    # edits file in place
```

The `s` means substitute. The format is `s/find/replace/`.

Add `g` at the end to replace ALL occurrences on each line:
```bash
sed -i 's/old/new/g' filename
```

## Assignment:
The auditors are coming. Quietly fix Steve's interest rate in `accounts/savings.txt` from `-0.21%` to `4.5%` before anyone notices. Use `sed -i` to edit in place. Then `cat` the file and paste the line showing Steve's new rate.
